description: Semantic probes for public multi-nozzle grouping, directed flush histories, and legacy metadata contracts.

mutants.test_filter: Multi-nozzle flush weight follows each nozzle's directed filament history
mutants.description: Reverse the directed from/to lookup. The asymmetric itinerary expects a scaled weight of 8, so the reversed lookup must fail an ordinary assertion.

mutants.test_filter: Legacy nozzle metadata keeps the first valid group record and converts extruder IDs once
mutants.description: Omit the one-based to zero-based conversion for a valid legacy record. The public fixture checks exact extruder IDs and fails as an ordinary assertion.
